caption: The image displays a monochromatic, likely grayscale rubbing or impression of a rectangular plaque with sculpted reliefs. The relief contains several objects and figures: on the left side, there are two trees, and beneath them stand three quadrupedal animals, possibly deer or similar creatures, with another animal, possibly a dog, above them. In the middle and right portions, there are two more trees, each with a standing human figure positioned next to each tree, one figure slightly right of the center and the other near the right edge of the plaque. The lower third of the plaque is occupied by a horizontal band of raised text, above a large oval containing the number “14” at the center. The lower left section of the plaque is damaged or missing, resulting in an irregular shape at the bottom. The entire composition has a roughly textured surface, and the image is set on a neutral light background.
title: Pa. German Stove Plate
